evidence_basis.disclosure: V2 failed and all V2 candidate results are known. V3 uses disjoint token windows, unchanged common-history margins, a checked power calculation, and a new dense-first lock.
evidence_basis.non_reinterpretation: V2 remains failed. V3 cannot retroactively change any V2 endpoint, result, interval, or decision.

case_stream.source_balance: eight short and eight 4K cases from each of 11 validation sources
case_stream.disjointness: all token windows are disjoint within v3 and from v2

checkpoint_source.limitation: The historical dense control has one seed and a 2.08% parameter mismatch; v3 qualifies runtime behavior, not architecture quality.

execution.dtype: BF16 activations with FP32 parameters and recurrent state where implemented
execution.full_path: recompute the complete common-history prefix at every generation step
execution.cached_path: one full prefill followed by one-token stateful decode
execution.case_failure_policy: retain non-finite, interrupted, OOM, and unevaluable cases; no silent replacement

strict_operator_state_export.rule: existing isolated operator, state, gradient, checkpoint, and CPU Transformers export parity thresholds remain mandatory

common_history_argmax_disagreement.estimand: candidate-minus-control disagreement rate with within-case steps kept together

high_margin_argmax_disagreement.unit: case with eligible steps pooled inside the case
high_margin_argmax_disagreement.estimand: candidate-minus-control disagreement rate among full-path margins at or above 0.1 logits

early_free_running_divergence.event: cached and recompute greedy tokens first differ before 32 generated tokens
early_free_running_divergence.estimand: candidate-minus-control event rate and first-divergence horizon
early_free_running_divergence.reason: one low-margin tie-break makes subsequent histories incomparable; dense diverges in 15-27% of v2 cases and 90%-powered five-point NI requires up to 1683 cases per seed/length

hard_guardrails: no cached/recompute disagreement when the full-path top-1/top-2 margin is at least 0.5 logits
every strict operator/state/export prerequisite remains passed

statistics.length_decision: every primary endpoint and hard guardrail must pass separately at 8, 64, 512, and 4096 tokens
statistics.candidate_decision: each KDA seed must pass separately; no averaging away a failed seed
statistics.multiplicity: intersection-union gate across primary endpoints, lengths, and seeds; every primary cell must pass

phase_order: commit the checked power analysis and disjoint provenance-only case stream
commit this v3 contract with every margin and resource limit frozen
evaluate and hash the dense control only
write the immutable v3 control lock
evaluate KDA seeds 42/43/44 only after the lock timestamp
apply paired case bootstrap and hard guardrails while reporting free-running risk without decision authority
rerun the Paper 1 baseline hardware preflight only if v3 passes
decision_scope: V3 may qualify common-history full-model CUDA cache behavior for the historical KDA topology or keep it blocked. It cannot alter the v2 failure, weaken strict operator correctness, claim model quality, promote an architecture, or authorize paper-scale training.
